subject.title: Feature - Implement paid certificate or badge for a manual review and approval of skills

question: Should ClawHub offer a paid expedited human-review certificate or badge for skills, and if so what assurance scope should that badge represent?
rationale: The checkout shows adjacent moderation and badge primitives but no settled product, payment, security, or assurance policy for a paid trust signal users may rely on.

options.title: Keep Policy Open First
options.body: Keep this issue open for maintainer product/security review before any implementation defines a paid public trust badge.

options.title: Approve A Paid Pilot
options.body: Define a limited pilot with criteria, payment/refund/SLA rules, reviewer authority, audit logs, expiry, revocation, and public wording before a code PR.

options.title: Reject Paid Review
options.body: Close or redirect the paid portion and handle trust through non-paid scanner, Official, publisher, or vetted-community policy work.

recommendation.title: Keep Policy Open First
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for maintainer product/security review before any implementation defines a paid public trust badge.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is the strongest history match for the current skill badge, manual override, and trust-surface implementation that this policy would change.
